Average depth indications are based on SCS soil profile descriptions, which are available to a depth of only 60 inches. For this reason, a number of soil series may possess suitable topsoil to a depth greater than 60 inches, as indicated by the notation +60. Percentages of areal extent of the various soil series are based on examination of highlighted soil maps, and hence are only approximate.
From the information in Table II-13, it was calculated that average suitable topsoil depths are approximately 19 inches on Tract II and 26 inches on Tract III.
